name: Universidade do Minho
summary: Public university on three campuses in Braga and Guimarães; its bachelor's are taught in Portuguese and entered via the national contest.

ib.text: With Portuguese, apply through the national contest: IB grade 50%, IB exams replacing entrance exams 50%; IB Portuguese A at HL can replace the Portuguese exam (2026 table).

notes: International Business (Braga) is taught partly in English, with compulsory units such as Calculus and Microeconomics I in Portuguese, so it is not listed as an English-taught degree.
UMinho's international-student contest is for non-EU citizens; EU students apply through the national contest.
